item.title: Man arrested and drugs seized after dramatic police pursuit from Antrim ends in crash near Templepatrick
item.description: A man has been arrested and a significant quantity of suspected Class A drugs seized following a dramatic police pursuit that began in the Antrim area and ended near Templepatrick on Monday evening, 29 December. Police say the incident unfolded shortly after 9pm when officers attending an unrelated report in Antrim observed a white Audi A4 behaving suspiciously. item.description: People across Northern Ireland are being encouraged to make use of the Health and Social Care (HSC) App Library this winter, with more than 1,000 endorsed health apps available to support physical and mental wellbeing. item.title: Myostatin and the suckler herd: what every beef farmer needs to know
item.description: An understanding of the myostatin gene can help producers to make informed decisions about their suckler herd breeding programme.
